```{r, build tiers}
source("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\code\\R\\tier_filtering.R")

# Tier <-> (site_scope, flag_criterion), in filtering order:
#   tier1 <- noG,  review_only
#   tier2 <- noG2, review_only
#   tier3 <- all,  review_only
#   tier4 <- noG2, full
#   tier5 <- all,  full
#   tier6 <- noG,  full

average_replicates <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Site, Tran, Dist, Month, Study.Phase) %>%   # match your location/month grain
    summarise(
      Flux = mean(Flux_rep, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_reps = sum(!is.na(Flux_rep)),
      Elevation_m = mean(Elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE), 
      z_star = mean(z_star, na.rm = TRUE), 
      across(-c(Flux_rep, Flux, Replicate, Elevation_m, z_star), first),  # carry other columns through unchanged
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# DECISION (committee feedback, both John and XiaoHang independently):
# keep replicates separate rather than only ever averaging them --
# averaging mutes real variability (esp. the Scarped-vs-Ramped skewness
# difference), and there's no strong statistical justification for
# averaging spatially distributed replicate traps. average_replicates()
# above is left UNCHANGED -- master_tier1-6 and everything downstream
# of them still default to the averaged grain. This function builds a
# second, parallel, replicate-level version instead of replacing it.
#
# Unlike average_replicates(), Flux is never touched here -- it's
# already the per-replicate value from elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, so
# there's nothing to rename/collapse. n_reps is still computed, for
# parity with the averaged version's n_reps > 0 filter below.
keep_replicates <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Site, Tran, Dist, Month, Study.Phase) %>%
    mutate(n_reps = sum(!is.na(Flux_rep))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Flux_rep)) %>%
    mutate(
      Loc_ID = interaction(Site, Tran, Dist, drop = TRUE)
    )
}


master_tier1 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG",  "review_only") %>% average_replicates()
master_tier2 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG2", "review_only") %>% average_replicates()
master_tier3 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "all",  "review_only") %>% average_replicates()
master_tier4 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG2", "full") %>% average_replicates()
master_tier5 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "all",  "full") %>% average_replicates()
master_tier6 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG",  "full") %>% average_replicates()

master_tier5 <- master_tier5 %>% filter(n_reps > 0)

# Raw-replicate companions for all six tiers -- built here for
# completeness/comparison purposes, but only master_tier5_byrep is
# actually used in any analysis further down this file (tier5 is the
# only tier used going forward). Same (site_scope, flag_criterion)
# pairing as each averaged tier above:
#   tier1 <- noG,  review_only   tier4 <- noG2, full
#   tier2 <- noG2, review_only   tier5 <- all,  full
#   tier3 <- all,  review_only   tier6 <- noG,  full
master_tier1_byrep <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG",  "review_only") %>% keep_replicates()
master_tier2_byrep <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG2", "review_only") %>% keep_replicates()
master_tier3_byrep <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "all",  "review_only") %>% keep_replicates()
master_tier4_byrep <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG2", "full")        %>% keep_replicates()
master_tier5_byrep <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "all",  "full")        %>% keep_replicates()
master_tier6_byrep <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_edge_flux, "noG",  "full")        %>% keep_replicates()

master_tier1_byrep <- master_tier1_byrep %>% filter(n_reps > 0)
master_tier2_byrep <- master_tier2_byrep %>% filter(n_reps > 0)
master_tier3_byrep <- master_tier3_byrep %>% filter(n_reps > 0)
master_tier4_byrep <- master_tier4_byrep %>% filter(n_reps > 0)
master_tier5_byrep <- master_tier5_byrep %>% filter(n_reps > 0)
master_tier6_byrep <- master_tier6_byrep %>% filter(n_reps > 0)

month_levels <- c("Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec",
                  "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun")


master_tier5 %>% count(n_reps)


master_tier1 <- master_tier1 %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier2 <- master_tier2 %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier3 <- master_tier3 %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier4 <- master_tier4 %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier5 <- master_tier5 %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier6 <- master_tier6 %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))

master_tier5_byrep <- master_tier5_byrep %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))

master_tier1_byrep <- master_tier1_byrep %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier2_byrep <- master_tier2_byrep %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier3_byrep <- master_tier3_byrep %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier4_byrep <- master_tier4_byrep %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))
master_tier6_byrep <- master_tier6_byrep %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels))


save_tier(master_tier1, "master_tier1.csv")
save_tier(master_tier2, "master_tier2.csv")
save_tier(master_tier3, "master_tier3.csv")
save_tier(master_tier4, "master_tier4.csv")
save_tier(master_tier5, "master_tier5.csv")
save_tier(master_tier6, "master_tier6.csv")

save_tier(master_tier5_byrep, "master_tier5_byrep.csv")

save_tier(master_tier1_byrep, "master_tier1_byrep.csv")
save_tier(master_tier2_byrep, "master_tier2_byrep.csv")
save_tier(master_tier3_byrep, "master_tier3_byrep.csv")
save_tier(master_tier4_byrep, "master_tier4_byrep.csv")
save_tier(master_tier6_byrep, "master_tier6_byrep.csv")
```

```{r, export tier5 tables to Word-ready images}

save_flux_table_image <- function(flux_result, caption, filename) {
  ft <- flux_result$data %>%
    dplyr::select(-Shapiro_p) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Shapiro_p = Shapiro_p_display) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    set_caption(caption) %>%
    colformat_double(digits = 3) %>%
    autofit()
  
  save_as_image(
    ft,
    path = paste0(
      "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\images\\rq_1\\",
      filename
    )
  )
  ft
}
```
